objective: 在不读取Phase50盲测标签的前提下，使用Phase48已提交的开发集训练样本，比较模型专属残差头与直方图形状加权损失，目标是把pure-PD六模型的calls和logical-bytes 12-bin histogram WAPE压到10%正式目标附近，并为后续一次性盲测冻结候选模型。

dataset_contract.group_isolation: six model rows for one profile stay in the same split and OOF fold
dataset_contract.complete_requests: not read by Phase54; only the compact Phase48 examples with low-dimensional features and H0/Hfull histograms are read
dataset_contract.phase50_blind: not read, not used for candidate selection, and not used for validation

representation_contract.input: Phase48 target-free low-dimensional profile features, model structure features, fixed pure-PD P1-D1 execution features, and H0 histogram
representation_contract.output: nonnegative topology-independent 12-bin calls and logical bytes per 1000 requests
representation_contract.total_and_shape: encoded output contains log total plus 12-bin log-share for calls and bytes; histogram reconstruction preserves nonnegativity
representation_contract.h0_protection: final prediction is H0 plus a bounded residual controlled by one alpha per model
representation_contract.shape_priority: candidate loss weights share logits more than totals because Phase50 total WAPE is already low while histogram WAPE is high
representation_contract.model_conditioning: shared candidates retain structure features; per-model candidates train a separate small residual head for each of the six known models

predictor_contract.selection_scope: Phase48 expanded_train profiles only; profile groups never split across folds
predictor_contract.candidate_score: mean of absolute calls histogram WAPE, bytes histogram WAPE, calls TV, and normalized log-payload EMD; H0-protected candidates are preferred

acceptance_gate.oof_protection: overall and every model strictly beat H0 on calls WAPE, bytes WAPE, calls TV and normalized payload EMD
acceptance_gate.development_formal_target: overall calls histogram WAPE <= 0.10 and bytes histogram WAPE <= 0.10
acceptance_gate.development_model_guard: each of six models has both histogram WAPE <= 0.15
acceptance_gate.development_segment_guard: each BurstGPT segment has both histogram WAPE <= 0.15 and composite ratio < 1
acceptance_gate.total_guard: overall calls total WAPE <= 0.05 and bytes total WAPE <= 0.05
acceptance_gate.phase55_permission: only a candidate satisfying OOF protection and the complete development gate may be frozen for a later blind evaluation; Phase54 itself is not blind evidence
acceptance_gate.negative_policy: integrity PASS with target_met=false is a valid development result but blocks Phase55

stop_and_block_if: any Phase48 pin or result manifest differs
Phase50 blind files or labels are opened
raw or complete request rows are read or written
GPU, network, model download, or original model weights are accessed
validation profiles influence candidate, alpha, or epoch selection
claim_boundary: development-only evidence on 1200 Phase48 profiles and six known model structures under pure P1-D1
not fresh blind evidence and not a Phase50 re-evaluation
not physical communication time, placement, latency, queueing, or online scheduling
Phase54 target_met only authorizes a separately specified blind-freeze/evaluation workflow
